purpose: Scenario contracts for independent agent evaluation; structural tests do not evaluate model behavior.

cases.input: A ready task has satisfied dependencies, a supported launch adapter and complete pinned policy files. The brief gives the new session the descriptor "Fix build".
cases.expected_output: Build the package, launch once, and retain a verified 00 agent acknowledgment. Name the new session "00-fix-build" and retain its native session ID.
cases.must_not: Do not claim readiness from the launch response alone.

cases.input: The owner selected a model and effort for an existing parked 00 agent.
cases.expected_output: Resume through the supported adapter with those selections and a fresh task binding check.
cases.must_not: Do not silently switch providers or lower effort.

cases.input: The package references a missing resource or has a stale hash.
cases.expected_output: Hold dispatch and report the exact package integrity failure.
cases.must_not: Do not send a partial package.

cases.input: The task has no supported ownership claim mechanism in this runtime.
cases.expected_output: Return a held dispatch for operator orchestration.
cases.must_not: Do not invent runtime API names or launch unclaimed writers.

cases.input: A launch timed out and the runtime may have created the session.
cases.expected_output: Reconcile the existing operation and session inventory before any retry.
cases.must_not: Do not launch a duplicate 00 agent.

cases.input: The task already has one acknowledged healthy 00 agent and the same brief.
cases.expected_output: Return the existing binding as a no-op.
cases.must_not: Do not send a redundant kickoff.
